acts.title: One stay, four short messages
text: Room 604. There’s a problem with the shower — the hot water stops after about a minute. I’ll be out until six. Could someone look at it while I’m gone? Many thanks. L. Samson
Checked in OK. Room’s fine apart from the shower. I’ve left a note at reception. Are we still meeting at seven in the lobby, or has that moved?
Dear Mr Samson, We have looked at the shower and replaced the part. Please call reception if it happens again — we will move you to another room. Sorry for the inconvenience. Housekeeping
Thanks for sorting the shower out so quickly. One more thing: could I have a spare key for my colleague, who arrives tomorrow morning? Room 604.

write.q: Write the four short messages from a stay of your own: a note to reception about a problem, a message to a colleague or friend, the reply you would want from the hotel, and a short thank-you with one more request. Follow the model’s six moves in the first note.
write.model: NOTE AT RECEPTION — Room 312. There’s a problem with the heating: the radiator is cold and the room is about fourteen degrees. I’ll be out until seven. Could someone look at it while I’m gone? Many thanks. A. Serikova — MESSAGE TO A FRIEND — Checked in. Room’s fine apart from the heating, which doesn’t work at all. I’ve left a note. Are we still meeting at eight downstairs? — FROM THE HOTEL — Dear Ms Serikova, We have looked at the radiator and replaced the valve. Please call reception if the room is still cold and we will move you. Sorry for the inconvenience. — MESSAGE TO RECEPTION — Thanks for sorting the heating out so quickly. One more thing: could I have a late checkout on Sunday? Room 312.

speak.q: Play both parts out loud: check in with a reservation, ask two questions, report a problem with the room, and as reception, take the details and promise action.
speak.model: I’d like to check in, please. I have a reservation under Serikova. Is breakfast included? What time is checkout? — There’s a problem with the heating. Could you send someone up? — Of course. I’ll get someone to look at it right away. Sorry for the inconvenience.
